kpis.name: Schedule Performance Index (SPI)
kpis.description: Measures schedule efficiency of earned value against planned value across the tower programme, detecting early drift in permitting, procurement, and floor-cycle phases.

kpis.name: Cost Performance Index (CPI)
kpis.description: Measures cost efficiency of earned value against actual cost, highlighting erosion from ground conditions, escalation, and claims.

kpis.name: Critical Path Float Burn Rate
kpis.description: Tracks consumption of total float on the critical path (typically through permitting, long-lead procurement, and substructure) week over week.
kpis.target: Float burn <= 0.5 days/week on critical path
kpis.formula: Float Burn = (Previous Float - Current Float) / Elapsed Weeks

kpis.name: Lost Time Injury Frequency Rate (LTIR)
kpis.description: Number of lost-time injuries per million hours worked, the headline safety indicator for the high-risk high-rise construction environment.
kpis.formula: LTIR = (Lost Time Injuries x 1,000,000) / Total Hours Worked

kpis.name: Near-Miss Reporting Rate
kpis.description: Volume of near-miss reports per 100,000 hours; a healthy rising rate indicates strong reporting culture, a falling rate signals under-reporting risk.
kpis.target: >= 8 reports per 100k hours with upward trend
kpis.formula: Near-Miss Rate = (Near-Miss Reports x 100,000) / Hours Worked

kpis.name: Working-at-Height Compliance Audit Score
kpis.description: Percentage compliance from weekly audits of edge protection, harness use, and rescue readiness across active tower floors and facade zones.
kpis.formula: Compliance Score = (Compliant Audit Items / Total Audit Items) x 100

kpis.name: Non-Conformance Report (NCR) Rate
kpis.description: NCRs raised per 1,000 installed units or per pour across structural, facade, and MEP scopes; tracks quality system health.
kpis.target: <= 5 NCRs per 1,000 units with closure <= 14 days
kpis.formula: NCR Rate = (NCRs Raised / Units Installed) x 1,000

kpis.name: Punch List Closeout Rate
kpis.description: Percentage of punch list items closed per week against raising rate during fit-out and handover; detects the snagging snowball before practical completion.
kpis.target: Closeout rate >= raising rate; >= 90% closed before PC walk

kpis.name: Facade Air/Water Test Pass Rate
kpis.description: Percentage of tested curtain wall and cladding zones passing air permeability and water spray criteria first time.
kpis.formula: Pass Rate = (Zones Passed First Time / Zones Tested) x 100

kpis.name: Core Jump Cycle Time
kpis.description: Average elapsed days per self-climbing core formwork jump; the pacing metric for vertical construction of the tower core.
kpis.formula: Average Jump Time = Total Jump Duration / Number of Jumps Completed

kpis.name: Slab Cycle Time (Days per Floor)
kpis.description: Elapsed days per typical post-tensioned floor from form to strip; the dominant productivity driver of superstructure duration.
kpis.formula: Slab Cycle = Sum(Floor Completion Durations) / Floors Completed

kpis.name: Tower Crane Utilization
kpis.description: Percentage of available crane hook-hours productively used versus idle, weather-stopped, or maintenance time; exposes logistics bottlenecks.
kpis.formula: Utilization % = (Productive Hook Hours / Available Hook Hours) x 100

kpis.name: Concrete Pour Volume vs Plan
kpis.description: Cumulative cubic metres placed against planned volume curve, validating supply chain reliability and cycle adherence for the concrete frame.
kpis.formula: Pour Variance % = (Actual Volume Placed / Planned Volume) x 100

kpis.name: Change Order Backlog Value
kpis.description: Total value of submitted-but-unresolved change orders; growing backlog signals commercial instability and unquantified programme risk.
kpis.target: Backlog <= 2% of contract value and falling

kpis.name: Subcontractor Claims Outstanding
kpis.description: Count and value of open subcontractor claims awaiting resolution; tracks commercial friction and litigation exposure.
kpis.target: Zero claims older than 60 days unresolved
kpis.formula: Outstanding Claims = Count(Open Claims) and Sum(Open Claim Values)

kpis.name: Snagging Closure Rate (Handover Readiness)
kpis.description: Ratio of closed snags to total open snags in the final quarter, weighted by category severity; predicts practical completion date reliability.
kpis.target: Closure rate >= 85% with zero open Category A at PC
kpis.formula: Closure Rate = (Closed Snags / Total Raised Snags) x 100

kpis.name: BREEAM/LEED Pre-Assessment Score Tracking
kpis.description: Current projected certification score against target rating, tracking credit evidence submission and design-stage score erosion.
kpis.formula: Score Attainment % = (Secured + Likely Credits / Credits Required for Target) x 100

kpis.name: Elevator Commissioning Milestones Achieved
kpis.description: Percentage of elevator/escalator commissioning milestones (installation, functional, safety, witness tests) achieved on schedule; protects the classic end-game bottleneck.
kpis.target: 100% of milestones on or ahead of schedule
kpis.formula: Milestone Achievement % = (Milestones Achieved On Time / Milestones Due) x 100
